name: Dragon Tribe
source:
Long ago a great battle was waged against the calamity known as the Shadow Fall. In this mighty battle, the race of Dragons fought long and hard to protect the world. Even their mighty power paled in comparison to the enemy they fought, until only eight remained.

These eight dragons, last of their kind, made a bargain, and in doing so gained the power of the eight elements that made up the world. Flame, Air, Ice, Nature, Power, Life, Death, and Spirit. Utilizing the very power of the world, they sacrificed themselves and the curtain of darkness that was the Shadow Fall faded, and light returned.

Thousands of years later, the power of these Elemental Dragons had passed into the blood of Eight Tribes. These became known as the Dragon Tribes. Humans that could awaken to the powers that the mighty dragon had once possessed. Taking up the mantle the dragons had passed, and protecting the world in their place.

On a day that seemed like any other, Frey Havarth, a man who wished for nothing but peace, beheld a vision of the future. In it he saw death, chaos and destruction. Leading this he saw the Death Dragon, Draco.

Frey could not sit around and let his vision come to pass. With the help of Katrine, a bar-master who he owed a large debt, he sets off on a journey to discover what he can do to stop this tragedy.

Accompanied by the Cargo Captain, Camila Nava, who is making sure he's not running from his debt, the two set sail for Frey's Hometown.

[From [url=https://tavayachi.com/?id=dragon-tribe]Official site[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，人们与被称为“暗影陨落”的灾厄展开了一场大战。在这场伟大战役中，龙族奋勇战斗，竭力守护世界。他们强大的力量在敌人面前也显得微不足道，最终只剩下八条龙。

这八条同族最后的巨龙达成约定，并因此获得了构成世界的八种元素之力：火焰、空气、冰、自然、力量、生命、死亡与精神。他们借用世界本身的力量牺牲自己，黑暗帷幕“暗影陨落”随之消散，光明重新降临。

数千年后，这些元素巨龙的力量流入八个部族的血脉。他们被称为龙族部落——能够觉醒强大巨龙曾拥有的力量的人类。他们继承巨龙留下的使命，代替巨龙守护世界。

在一个看似平凡的日子里，渴望和平的弗雷·哈瓦斯看见了未来的幻象。他在其中看到了死亡、混乱与毁灭，并看见了引领这一切的死亡之龙德拉科。

弗雷无法坐视幻象成真。在欠下酒吧老板卡特琳一大笔债的情况下，他在她的帮助下踏上旅程，寻找阻止这场悲剧的方法。

货运船长卡米拉·纳瓦陪伴着他，确保他不会逃债。两人乘船驶向弗雷的故乡。

（来源：[url=https://tavayachi.com/?id=dragon-tribe]官方网站[/url]）
